name: Revamp Moto
tagline: Nashik maker of modular electric two-wheelers with swappable attachments
excerpt: Nashik EV maker Revamp Moto raised ₹1 crore from Aman Gupta and Anupam Mittal on Shark Tank India Season 1.
content:
Revamp Moto builds a modular electric two-wheeler, the Buddie, whose swappable attachments (child seat, back rack, insulated box, carrier) let one vehicle serve families, delivery riders and small traders. Co-founder and CEO Pritesh Mahajan pitched it in the fifth episode of Shark Tank India, aired on 24 December 2021, asking for ₹1 crore for 1%.

Aman Gupta and Anupam Mittal invested ₹1 crore for 1.5%. The Better India reports that Ashneer Grover and Peyush Bansal each added ₹50 lakh after the show.

Inc42's records list a pre-seed round in May 2022 and a seed round in June 2024. Filings show revenue was still very small in FY24 with a sizeable loss, as is common for a hardware start-up before scale.

faq.q: Did Revamp Moto get a deal on Shark Tank India?
faq.a: Yes. Aman Gupta and Anupam Mittal invested ₹1 crore for 1.5% in Season 1, Episode 5.
Yes. It filed accounts for FY24 and raised a seed round in June 2024.
Inc42's filing data shows total revenue of about ₹21.9 lakh in FY24, with a net loss.

lessons: Our analysis: designing for micro-entrepreneurs' real jobs, not just commuting, gave the product a clear buyer.
Our analysis: a high on-air valuation can still work when the sharks believe in the long hardware runway, but revenue takes years to follow.
